rules.statement: A person is said to have notice of a fact either when he actually knows that fact, or when, but for willful abstention from inquiry or gross negligence, he would have known it, or when information of the fact is given to or obtained by any person whom the court may determine to have been his agent for the purpose of receiving or obtaining such information
